clock: UTC, fixed all year: the canonical clock of the pinned B2 EURUSD source tape. No daylight-saving shift is applied.
holiday_rule: No expected open from 22:00 UTC on the previous calendar day until 23:00 UTC on the holiday.
session_id_rule: UTC date of (open + 3 hours), so the trading day rolls at 21:00 UTC; a Saturday result is assigned to Friday.
bars_outside_calendar: A source bar outside the expected opens is excluded from the evaluation tape and counted; it never extends the calendar.
basis: Rule-based standard spot-FX week (Sunday evening to Friday evening New York, closed Christmas Day and New Year's Day), expressed on the feed's fixed UTC clock. The weekly open/close hours were set to the feed's observed regular hours; no individual closure or gap was inferred from bars.
limitations: The feed clock is fixed in UTC, so the open and close do not follow the 17:00 New York convention across daylight-saving changes.
Holiday early closes (for example 24 and 31 December afternoons) are not modelled; missing bars there are data gaps, not closures.
